parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The source of the request. Set the value to **sas**, which indicates that the request is sent from Security Center.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUIDs of the assets to query. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,). You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to query the UUIDs of assets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-instance-statistics --source-ip 1.2.XX.XX --lang zh --uuid 6690a46c-0edb-4663-a641-3629d1a90000 --from sas --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeInstanceStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '1.2.XX.XX' --Uuid '6690a46c-0edb-4663-a641-3629d1a90000' --Lang zh --From sas
